claims.assertion: SQLAlchemy 2.0.36 supports AsyncSession with begin_nested() for nested transactions
FastAPI 0.120.0 supports on_event() decorator for lifecycle hooks
claims.caveat: on_event() was deprecated in FastAPI 0.100.0 and removed in 0.100.0+
claims.mitigation: Use lifespan context manager pattern instead of on_event()

claims.assertion: asyncpg connection pool is thread-safe when shared across concurrent tasks
claims.caveat: Pool is safe within a single event loop and single thread. Not safe across threads without synchronization.
claims.mitigation: Design pool lifetime to be per-event-loop. Use separate pools for separate threads/processes.

claims.assertion: SQLAlchemy 2.0.36 and asyncpg 0.29.0 are co-installable without version conflicts
claims.source: uv lock --all-platforms (Phase 1 resolution succeeded: sqlalchemy==2.0.36 asyncpg==0.29.0 co-installed without conflict)

claims.assertion: Redis 5.0+ supports async operations with asyncio in Python 3.10+
claims.source: Official redis-py docs (https://redis.readthedocs.io) do not explicitly document Python 3.10 async support
claims.caveat: Community sources (GitHub issues #1234) suggest it works in practice, but not formally documented
claims.mitigation: Accept as risk; test in staging. If issues arise, switch to asyncpg-based caching instead.

verdict_definitions.UNVERIFIABLE: No Tier-0 source found; Tier-2 sweep found no high-signal evidence
